Eala faces Antonia Ruzic in the QF round
 Alexandra “Alex” Eala will face Croatia’s Antonia Ruzic in the quarterfinals of the Hong Kong Tennis Open on Friday night.
 Eala booked her place in the last eight after defeating Tereza Valentova, 6-4, 7-6(7) , in the second round on Thursday.
